tools.name: aw.status
tools.description: Read public beta coverage and service limits.

tools.name: aw.catalog
tools.description: Find supported public beta workflows by task.

tools.name: aw.session.open
tools.description: Create a private15-minute remote processing session. No local installation and no personal input is sent by opening it.

tools.name: aw.session.close
tools.description: Explicitly revoke this transient remote session and remove its remote copies; original disk files are never touched.

tools.name: aw.jobs.list
tools.description: Statuses for this session only, without selected audio or private URLs.

tools.name: aw.jobs.cancel
tools.description: Retire active work AND in-flight uploads that have not committed. Completed immutable inputs/artifacts are not deleted. Stable upload UUID/operationId reconcile committed receipts. Bounded32 cancellation requests remain available after ordinary quota exhaustion; close clears active copies.

tools.name: aw.artifact.verify
tools.description: Re-read authenticated chunks and hash an actual current-session artifact; return metadata, never audio bytes.

tools.name: aw.transfer.guide
tools.description: Explicit native MCP file-transfer contract, bounds and client-history privacy. Discovery does not read your disk.

tools.name: aw.input.begin
tools.description: Reserve bounded encrypted staging for one explicitly selected file. NO source publication or job retirement until validated commit;2 pending/max24 identities.

tools.name: aw.input.write_chunk
tools.description: Append one exact canonical-base6432768-byte chunk (last=remainder) to this attempt in order. Exact retries reconcile; binary bodies may reach client/model history.

tools.name: aw.input.status
tools.description: Resume this exact transfer attempt without returning any selected bytes. Retired/complete state is explicit.

tools.name: aw.input.commit
tools.description: Verify ALL staged bytes/hash/original format and atomically publish one current immutable input. Exact completed retries recover its receipt; invalid/partial data never retires a job.

tools.name: aw.input.abort
tools.description: Discard this pending transfer attempt only; does not cancel the current processing job or delete a completed immutable input. Use jobs.cancel for all pending stages.

tools.name: aw.artifact.read_chunk
tools.description: Return one bounded binary embedded resource from this session artifact, plus range/whole-file hashes. Reassemble and hash ALL bytes. Not disk-save or whole-file verification from one range.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aw.jobs.list, aw.speech.transcribe, aw.speech.transcript.read · Private data: aw.session.close, aw.jobs.list, aw.transfer.guide, aw.input.begin, aw.artifact.read_chunk, aw.speech.whisper_encode_step, aw.speech.whisper_decode_step, aw.speech.transcribe, aw.speech.transcript.clear · Public sink: aw.jobs.cancel, aw.input.commit, aw.speech.whisper_encode_step, aw.speech.whisper_decode_step · Destructive: aw.session.close, aw.input.commit, aw.input.abort, aw.speech.whisper_decode_step, aw.speech.transcribe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aw.jobs.list, aw.speech.transcribe, aw.speech.transcript.read · Private data: aw.session.close, aw.jobs.list, aw.transfer.guide, aw.input.begin, aw.artifact.read_chunk, aw.speech.whisper_encode_step, aw.speech.whisper_decode_step, aw.speech.transcribe, aw.speech.transcript.clear · Public sink: aw.jobs.cancel, aw.input.commit, aw.speech.whisper_encode_step, aw.speech.whisper_decode_step · Destructive: aw.session.close, aw.input.commit, aw.input.abort, aw.speech.whisper_decode_step, aw.speech.transcribe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
